overview.description: The Harbor AlphaEdge Large Cap Value ETF (AELV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Harbor AlphaEdge Large Cap Value index. The fund tracks an index that targets attractively valued large-cap US stocks. The fund employs a proprietary model and optimizer that uses fundamental and technical factors in selecting and weighting securities. AELV was launched on Aug 20, 2024 and is issued by Harbor.
